mechanism: Both agents cause skin irritation and inflammation through different pathways; tretinoin increases skin sensitivity and latanoprost can cause local ocular/periocular irritation, potentially additive dermatologic effects if tretinoin is applied periocularly.
action: Avoid concurrent periocular application of tretinoin; if tretinoin is used on face, maintain distance from eye area and monitor for excessive irritation, erythema, or peeling at application sites.
